characters.name: 성인 남성
characters.design: Korean man about 40, stocky body, large rounded-square face, broad cheeks, large rounded nose, thick brows, black side-swept hair, dark rectangular glasses, cream rolled-sleeve shirt, mustard tie, navy trousers, brown shoes, gold watch

characters.name: 성인 여성
characters.design: Korean adult woman about 35-38, elegant slim fit feminine silhouette with defined waist and long legs, modern stylish professional, adult proportions about five heads tall while still clearly caricatured in the UP-inspired animated universe. Gracefully rounded oval face, expressive dark eyes, softly arched brows, small rounded nose, NO glasses. Sleek dark chestnut shoulder-length bob with soft side part, tiny gold stud earrings. Tailored muted teal blazer over a cream blouse, tailored navy knee-length pencil skirt, hem at the knees, professional office silhouette, mustard low-heel pumps, slim gold wristwatch. Confident friendly composed posture, polished contemporary office outfit, fully clothed, mature adult.

characters.name: 남자 어린이
characters.design: Korean boy about 10, unmistakable child age and proportions, large rounded-square head, soft round cheeks, small button nose, thick short black hair with two distinctive upward tufts, no glasses, mustard sweatshirt over a cream collar, teal knee-length shorts, navy socks and cream sneakers. Natural child build, expressive curiosity, fully clothed age-appropriate everyday appearance.

characters.name: 여성 청소년
characters.design: Korean high-school girl about 17, clearly teenage face and natural teen body proportions, confident K-pop fan who loves edgy street fashion. Bright cherry-red dyed shoulder-length layered hair with side-swept fringe, dark expressive eyes, no glasses, small silver hoop earrings, simple layered silver necklaces and silver bracelets. Black leather biker jacket worn open over an oversized full-length cream graphic-free T-shirt covering waist and hips, opaque matte black leggings, chunky cream high-top sneakers, small black crossbody bag with silver hardware. Fully clothed age-appropriate nonsexual streetwear, no bare midriff, no cleavage, no heels. Original rounded appealing 3D animated character, expressive and assertive rather than demure.
scenes: 거울 앞에서 빨간 머리 스타일 정리

style.title: 따뜻한 3D 이야기
style.description: 큰 둥근 얼굴, 캐릭터별로 구분되는 체형, 크림·남색·겨자색, 부드러운 조명과 입체 재질. 딸은 빨간 머리와 검은 스트리트룩을 고유 색으로 사용합니다.
rules: 캐릭터마다 최신 기준 정면을 참조하고 얼굴·머리·체형을 유지
성인 여성: 안경 없이 날씬한 체형, 재킷과 스커트 오피스룩
여성 청소년: 고등학생, 빨간 머리·검은 가죽 재킷·레깅스·액세서리의 비성적인 스트리트 패션
새 수정본은 원본을 덮어쓰지 않고 별도 버전으로 보관
